## Bad event

A change merges without an exact-content review by a non-author, trusted CI passing on exactly that content, or (for sensitive surfaces, by trusted diff) an exact-content non-author security review. NO formal claim about backdoors: whether reviewed, tested code contains a backdoor is a semantic judgement.
